finding: WorkshopJei does not call getString(). TalismanDiscovery creates translatable components. JEI 15.59.0.210 expands translated contents into literal components during ingredient-info registration, retaining the initial language. The information layout additionally caches wrapped lines.

research.method: Pinned full-method source + AST localization calls/guards/arguments/text-consumer analysis at every counted site, compact source-context review across the ledger, selected deep lifecycle traces. Not 1000 manually executed mods or 1000 independent algorithms.
research.native_chain_note: Original seven bytecode chain sites remain diagnosis evidence; not added to the new 1000 count.

references.observation: Hands original components to IngredientInfoRecipe.create; no Dynasty getString call is involved.
Immediately calls StringUtil.expandNewlines and stores the returned description list.
Visits styled component content with current Language before storing it.
Receives resolved String chunks and creates Component.literal via m_237113_; translation keys are lost.
Uses the stored description to create a scroll box for the information page.
Creates a DrawableWrappedText when the layout is constructed.
Constructor splits and caches descriptionLines. Later draw reads current Language only for visual ordering of already flattened lines.

acceptance_split.hot_switch: Original run02 failure retained; repaired jar run06 zh→en→zh all seven pages and native back navigation passed.

implemented.change: Replace only seven addIngredientInfo convenience registrations with seven IJeiIngredientInfoRecipe instances registered under existing RecipeTypes.INFORMATION. Each retains typed item identity and translatable description components / translation-key supplier, rather than calling JEI flattening factory. getDescription evaluates TalismanDiscovery.details for the current language. Keep the native information category and input/output focus, original recipes and IDs. This can be nested in the same Java file.
implemented.validation_needed: Actual zh→en→zh switching with page close/reopen and back history; inspect recipe-layout wrapped-text caching. If old visible layouts survive, add a narrowly scoped refresh for these seven layouts on language resource reload. Do not rebuild/hide unrelated recipes or reset JEI globally.
implemented.confidence: Confirmed run06 zh→en→zh actual description AND native cached wrapped lines; 216/216. Native page/back-history layout rebuild suffices in tested flow; no global JEI reset or custom resource listener needed.
